name: Mato Kenkyouden Masked Shanghai
original_name: 魔都拳侠傳 マスクド上海
source:
Shanghai 1938. Shunsaku is a cyborg. His mission is to seal evil spirits. He comes to Shanghai to battle the increasing number of monsters in town. It is all due to a new corporations meddling with powers beyond their control in their pursuit of money and power.

But the city is filled with the kind of people he never fought against before and he has a hard time understanding who is a friend who is an enemy spy. In the back alleys a nightlife filled with prostitutes, drug addicts, murderers... Will he be able to survive and complete his mission?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=503425]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
1938年，上海。俊作是一名改造人，使命是封印恶灵。为对抗城中日益增多的怪物，他来到上海。这一切都源于一家新兴企业为追逐金钱与权力，贸然染指了无法控制的力量。

然而，城里尽是他从未应付过的人物，他很难辨明谁是朋友，谁又是敌方间谍。后巷中充斥着妓女、吸毒者与杀人犯构成的夜生活……他能否活下来并完成使命？

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=503425]Getchu[/url]]
